item.title: Pimax Crystal Pro. Wireless Native Foveated Streaming.
item.dc:creator: pimaxofficial
item.content:encoded:
Pimax Crystal Pro. Wireless Native Foveated Streaming.
With eye tracking, Crystal Pro dynamically sends the native GPU signal to your focus area through 60G Airlink, without additional codec or compression. The focus zone updates frame by frame as your gaze moves.
DisplayPort-grade quality. Wirelessly.
✅ Native GPU signal in your focus area ✅ Dynamic frame-by-frame foveated streaming ✅ 6+ Gbps through two MIMO paths ✅ Under 2ms added latency ✅ XR2 chip for frame synchronization ✅ Wi-Fi fallback + Pimax Play management ✅ Airlink Pro mode with ~10 Gbps combined bandwidth
Learn more: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lhJ5d1qS5cM https://x.com/pimaxofficial/status/2108935587537231983/video/1
